criteria.requirement: Add Slide.transition proxy with nonmutating configuration read, configure fade/push/wipe with XSD l/r/u/d directions, slow/med/fast speed, bool advance_on_click and optional unsignedInt advance_after_ms; clear explicitly removes transition. Validate entire update before mutation, insert p:transition before timing/extLst per pinned pml.xsd, preserve existing attrs/sound/extensions, refuse unknown existing effect replacement until explicit clear. Real PPTX XML/reopen proof; no autoplay execution, precise visual-effect duration or rendering claim.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
